items.options: Skype, Google chat, Microsoft Teams, telephone

items.question: Write four items we buy from the post office.
Define Communication.
items.answer: Communication is the process of sending and receiving messages. It also means exchanging ideas and information with others.

items.question: Why do we use applications such as Google Chat?
items.answer: Applications such as Google Chat help us to connect visually and audibly with someone regardless of where we are located.

items.question: What is mass communication?
items.answer: Mass communication is when we communicate to a large number of people at once. Example: if we have to share the name of a new leader with the people of the world, we will give the news through newspaper, radio, or television broadcast. It will appear as a headline in the newspaper and breaking news on the news channel.

items.question: What is an e-reader? How is it useful for you?
items.answer: An e-reader is a small gadget on which we can read books by downloading books from the internet.

items.question: Tanya has to send a copy of her school admission form instantly from Delhi to USA. Which means of communication should she use? Why should she use it?
items.answer: Tanya can use the internet and a computer device to send an e-mail. She can e-mail a scanned copy of her school admission form instantly.

items.question: How have satellites made communication easier?
answer: a) Satellites are electronic devices that are sent to space.
b) They collect information and have made communication easier and faster.
c) Satellites help us to watch cable television channels all over the world.
d) Satellites pick up signals from one place and send them to different parts of the world.

items.question: Anita lives in Mumbai. Anita's grandfather uses the courier service to send her home-made cookies on her birthday. Why does he choose courier service to send cookies?
items.answer: Anita's grandfather chooses the courier service to send her cookies because they will reach her in a day or two.
